paragraphs: Pappa. Abba ben Pappa; Avimi ben Pappa; Rav Shmuel ben Pappa. [Glosses: Pappa. (1) Hullin 54a: ‘Rav Pappa bar Abba the fowler.’ It seems to me that it should read ‘those of Pappa's household’; it was not corrected [ל״ת, provisional reading]. (2) Hagigah 14, end of a: ‘Rav Pappa bar Yaakov.’ In Ein Yaakov and Yalkut, Isaiah, section 3: ‘R' Aha bar Yaakov’; it was not corrected [ל״ת, provisional reading].]
